description.value: The Little Prairie Heritage Museum is a community heritage museum near Chetwynd in the Peace River region of Northern BC, preserving the history of the Little Prairie settlement area. It sits in a remote and scenic part of the province that touring cyclists traversing the region may pass through. The museum maintains a Facebook presence at the contact listed in OSM.
